Bug_Details: Using an unnecessarily-wide comparison method can lead to lossy comparison Implicit widening conversions when comparing two primitives with methods like Float.compare can lead to lossy comparison. For example, Float.compare(Integer.MAX_VALUE, Integer.MAX_VALUE - 1) == 0. Use a compare method with non-lossy conversion, or ideally no conversion if possible.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by using Float.compare to compare two integer values. This leads to a lossy comparison because Float.compare implicitly widens the integers to floats, which can result in incorrect comparisons for large integer values.
